previous_statement: Node 1.2.1 proves the amended claim directly: compression idempotence identifies S_{A,B} with im(Co_{A,B}), compression adjointness sends Co_{A,B}(a) to Co_{B,A}(a^dagger), and its A=B=Q instance gives tilde Q^dagger=tilde Q. The former reversal conjunct has deliberately been removed: with the allowed inputs, the identity (a dot b)^dagger=b^dagger dot a^dagger is not derivable because no allowed or registered definition identifies a dot b with Co_{A,C}(ab). Consequently this amended node must not be used to justify the dot-reversal step in node 1.3.2; completing the root requires provisioning and registering def-compressed-corner (or another allowed axiom that explicitly defines dot), followed by a separately verified reversal node.
new_statement: The registered definition compressed-product-display supplies the previously missing identity: for delta-projections A,B,C and compatible a in S_{A,B}, b in S_{B,C}, one has a dot b=Co_{A,C}(ab). Together with node 1.2.1 and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities at n=1, this gives the exact reversal identity (a dot b)^dagger=b^dagger dot a^dagger. Thus the earlier negative scope assertion and the claimed need for further definition provisioning are withdrawn.
